meanings.en: great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or objective
meanings.exampleEn: She pursued her new career with great zeal and determination.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni kariyerini büyük bir şevk ve kararlılıkla sürdürdü.

meanings.en: a place marked with black and white stripes where vehicles must stop to let pedestrians cross the road
meanings.exampleEn: Always look both ways before you use the zebra crossing.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaya geçidini kullanmadan önce her zaman iki tarafa da bak.

meanings.en: to fasten something using a zip
meanings.exampleEn: It's cold outside, so zip up your jacket before you leave.
meanings.exampleTr: Dışarısı soğuk, o yüzden çıkmadan önce ceketinin fermuarını çek.
